description: Diagonal of the spillover matrix for finetuned models: each finetuned (axis, pole) model is evaluated on its own axis's eval, with no system prompt and the first 100 test-split items (matches run_new_evals_ft.py defaults). Scope: axes listed in evals/def_sys_plusminus.json. Families: llama, qwen, nemotron. Job list is rebuilt from an on-disk scan of cross-elicit/models/ (latest timestamp per (axis, pole) within each family). status='done' = matching summary exists; 'todo' = needs to be run; 'unresolved' = no epoch-5 checkpoint yet.
